description: The exact command matrix is not a complete binary adjudication plan. Focused L1 explicitly permits its expected count to be changed later, while full regression fixes the baseline count even though Phase 2 adds test files; PROP-009 historical hash/mode immutability, PROP-010 gate/contract/traceability assertions, artifact-schema and safe secret/PII scans have no exact executable command with expected count and evidence path; and the separately authorized L3 command named by the matrix is absent. Replace mutable or baseline-only counts with exact final RED/GREEN contracts, and add exact executable commands, exits/counts, bound evidence paths, and binary thresholds for every omitted process, historical-immutability, artifact-schema, secret/PII, traceability, and controlled-L3 obligation.
